- **Water Reminder**: Keeps you hydrated with regular, c"},{"id":"p22s9","text":"ustomizable drinking prompts."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## Plugin Platform & SDK v3"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"The OpenPets plugin system offers a secure, developer-friendly SDK (`@open-pets/plugin-sdk`) for cre"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"ating custom companion behavior."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"### Security & Architecture
- **Sandboxed Runtime**: Each JS plugin runs inside a sandboxed BrowserW"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"indow host environment.
- **Host-Rendered UI**: Plugins describe actions, HUDs, and notifications; t"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"he desktop host renders them. HTML/JS code cannot render raw HTML or execute arbitrary scripting ins"},{"id":"p25s4","text":"ide a pet window.
- **Permissions Model**: Permissions must be declared in the manifest and approved"},{"id":"p25s5","text":" by the user at install. Flagged sensitive APIs (like `voice:listen`, `clipboard`, and `pet:speak:dy"},{"id":"p25s6","text":"namic`) require explicit consent toggles.
- **SSRF & Private Host Guards**: Network fetch requests a"},{"id":"p25s7","text":"re limited to developer-declared hostnames and guarded against local SSRF."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"### How it works
When you configure an agent, OpenPets exposes standard MCP tools. The agent can tri"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"gger animations, change status, and display text bubbles locally:
1. **Claude Code**: Installs OpenP"},{"id":"p26s3","text":"ets MCP, memory instructions in `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md`, and hooks in `~/.claude/settings.json`.
2. **"},{"id":"p26s4","text":"OpenCode**: Installs OpenPets MCP, custom project instruction files, and the `@open-pets/opencode` a"},{"id":"p26s5","text":"utomatic hook plugin.
3. **Devin Desktop + Devin CLI**: Adds OpenPets MCP to the shared `~/.config/d"},{"id":"p26s6","text":"evin/mcp_config.json` plus lifecycle hooks for both (`openpets configure --agent devin`).
4. **Curso"},{"id":"p26s7","text":"r / Other MCP Clients**: Register OpenPets as a standard stdio or TCP MCP server."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"### Local Privacy & Safety
- All automated reactions run on static local triggers (e.g., when a comm"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"and runs or a file is written).
- Speech content is validated to prevent leaking sensitive variables"},{"id":"p27s3","text":", paths, secrets, or multiline code snippets.
- Real-time interaction requires a local discovery tok"},{"id":"p27s4","text":"en write/read, protecting the IPC bridge from external network triggers."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"### Prerequisites
- **Node.js**: version 20 or higher
- **pnpm**: version 11 or higher
- **TypeScrip"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"t**: compiler support"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"## Safety and Privacy"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"- **Local-Only**: OpenPets IPC works using a local socket/named pipe, secured with a per-run random "},{"id":"p30s2","text":"security token.
- **SSRF Safety**: Plugin network connections are restricted to approved domains and"},{"id":"p30s3","text":" blocked from local network/private IP access.
- **Dynamic Content Sanitization**: Any dynamic AI-sp"},{"id":"p30s4","text":"eech text runs through strict local filters to redact paths, URLs, secrets, or multiline code snippe"},{"id":"p30s5","text":"ts.
- **Sensitive Permission Consent**: Features accessing clipboard, microphone, or dynamic AI resp"},{"id":"p30s6","text":"onses are off by default and require explicit user opt-in."}],"truncated":true}
